rankContract.window: last n axis points including current

eventContract.trigger: False-to-true transition, not every true day
eventContract.entry: Strictly first actual target observation later than eventDate
eventContract.baseline: Mean target N-observation forward return over all eligible target start points in loaded range
eventContract.winRate: Fraction sample returns strictly greater than baseline
eventContract.directionWinRate: If meanExcess positive use fraction>baseline; if negative fraction<baseline; zero null
eventContract.returnRounding: Return result d rounds4 decimal places
eventContract.unsupported: No original basket/source formula or publication point-in-time proof established by these engine functions
